description: Grid eXchange Fabric, formerly Open Smart Grid Platform, is the LF Energy project's software for controlling and monitoring infrastructure devices. It connects web applications to public-lighting, smart-metering and power-quality domains through device protocols and web services. Inputs are device registrations, operator commands and measurements; outputs are device responses, monitoring values and logs. Coverage and timing depend on the installed device network, not a supplied geographic dataset. Apache-2.0 source includes integration tests and a public-lighting demonstration application. A material limitation is that the project has retired to emeritus status and its repositories are no longer maintained. GXF can supply the control and observation layer for infrastructure digital-twin experiments, although it does not itself provide a physical network solver. OpenLEADR (platform-openleadr) provides a related demand-response interface. No software was installed or connected to devices.
